set.next_deadline: No open PBV competition as of November 8, 2026. The 2026-2030 Five-Year PHA Plan (adopted September 29, 2026) reports a prior competitive PBV selection and PBVs committed to El Dorado Haven, and its section B.5 contains no statement of intent to make non-competitive PBV selections, so a non-competitive award would need a plan amendment first. Contact the PHA (530-621-6300) to ask about a future PBV RFP.
set.cycle_notes: PBVs are awarded through PHA-issued competitive selections when vouchers are available, not on a fixed schedule. Non-competitive selection under 24 CFR 983.51(c) requires a statement of intent in the 5-Year Plan or an amendment; the 2026-2030 plan has none.
set.prevailing_wage_basis: 24 CFR 983.153(c) (HUD PBV development requirements): for new construction or rehabilitation under a PBV Agreement involving nine or more contract units, the owner and contractors must pay federal Davis-Bacon wages and the PHA must monitor compliance. https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-24/subtitle-B/chapter-IX/part-983/subpart-D. PBVs on existing housing with no development activity are not covered.
set.layering_notes: PBVs are the one County-controlled operating subsidy available for supportive housing in El Dorado, and with about 417 vouchers the pool is about 80 PBVs at most, several already committed to El Dorado Haven. A project with 10 to 20 PSH units should open the conversation with HHSA early and align with the EDOK Continuum of Care Coordinated Entry, which the PHA references. PBVs on a newly built or rehabilitated project with nine or more contract units trigger federal Davis-Bacon wages under 24 CFR 983.153(c); they do not by themselves trigger state prevailing wage, but state funding layered in usually does. The HCV program is federal; the PHA has no local rental assistance money. The Tahoe Basin is in the county PHA's jurisdiction but check overlap with the City of South Lake Tahoe programs.
